workStep.headline: TSRV - F/BLADE REPLACEMENT/SPECIFIC BLADRES FROM STOCK REQUIRED.
workStep.description:
PERFORM EO.18/086 COMPONENT (ENGINEERING ORDER) REV. 00 PARTNO : CFM56-7BE / SERIALNO : 854454 ENGINE - EVOLUTION POS: #1
BLAMAP & VIBRATION SURVEY REQUIRED AFTER FAN BLADE REPLACEMENT.
BACKGROUND: REF WO 40137990, #1 ENG FAN BLADES IN POSITION #4, #6, #8, #12 & #17 REQUIRE REPLACEMENT WITHIN 50 FC. ACCORDING TO DELIVERY EDS AND CONFIRMATION BY MOST RECENT BLADE INSPECTION, BELOW SN`S CORRELATE

BLADES TO BE INSTALLED IN BELOW CONFIG (SEE BLAMAP ATTACHED)
1 DM176487 340-001-036-0 210580 2 DM176144 340-001-036-0 210250 3 DM176723 340-001-036-0 210040 4 DM176757 340-001-036-0 209870 5 DM176827 340-001-036-0 210110 6 DM176833 340-001-036-0 210540 7 DM166172 340-001-038-0 210545 8 DM176721 340-001-036-0 210150 9 DM176842 340-001-036-0 209920 10 DM176664 340-001-036-0 209730 11 DC975895 340-001-038-0 210082 12 DM176844 340-001-036-0 210400 13 DM176834 340-001-036-0 210590 14 DM176925 340-001-036-0 210250 15 DM008178 340-001-038-0 210025 16 DM176752 340-001-036-0 209880 17 DM176447 340-001-036-0 210090 18 DM176747 340-001-036-0 210500 19 DM176153 340-001-036-0 210530 20 DM002229 340-001-038-0 210188 21 DM176369 340-001-036-0 209990 22 DM176840 340-001-036-0 209720 23 DM123934 340-001-038-0 210047 24 DM176854 340-001-036-0 210380
**NOTE: CRITICAL TASK - INDEPENDENT INSPECTION REQUIRED. REFER TO APPLICABLE CAME OR MOE.***
**** THIS TASK MUST BE FULLY SUPERVISED BY AN APPROPRIATELY APPROVED ENGINEER AT ALL TIMES ****
BACKGROUND: A BLAMAP HAS BEEN GENERATED TO RECONFIGURE THE BLADES INSTALLED ON THIS ENGINE. PLEASE FOLLOW INSTRUCTIONS BELOW TO INSTALL THIS BLAMAP.
ACTION: 1. OBSERVING ALL SAFETY PRECAUTIONS GAIN ACCESS TO THE ENGINE
2. REMOVE COMPLETE FAN BLADE SET IAW AMM TASK 72-21-02-000-801-F00.
NOTE: FAN BLADES WILL BE INSTALLED IN A DIFFERENT CONFIGURATION
3. CLEAN ALL DIRT AND UNWANTED MATERIAL FROM THE FAN BLADE ROOTS, FAN DISK DOVETAIL SLOTS & SHIMS AND FAN BLADES SURFACE IAW AMM TASK 72-21-00-640-801-F00 PARA G.1 & TASK 72-00-00-100-802-F00
4. ACCOMPLISH FAN MODULE INSPECTION IAW AMM TASK 72-21-02-200-801-F00 NOTE: REPORT ANY FINDINGS TO POWERPLANT@RYANAIR.COM
NOTE: REFER TO TECHNICAL TIP 72-010 - DURING INSPECTION OF THE FAN BLADE PLATFORM, IF ANY PLATFORM LUG IS FOUND CRACKED, THE DAMAGED PLATFORM MUST BE REPLACED. IF STOCK AVAILABLE, REPLACE ALL REMAINING PLAFORMS OTHERWISE RAISE A W/O IAW THE APPLICABLE OPERATOR`S CAME FOR REPLACEMENT OF THE REMAINING PLAFORMS WITHIN 500FH/300FC.
5. CONFIRM P/N OF THE PLATFORMS INSTALLED. RECORD IF THERE IS AN INTERMIX OF 816/817 PLATFORMS. INTERMIX OF PLATFORMS IS ALLOWABLE PROVIDED THEY ARE PLACED 180 DEG APART IN THE ENGINE. A FULL SHIPSET OF EITHER 816 OR 817 IS PREFERABLE IF STOCK LEVELS ALLOW FOR IT
6. REFERENCE ATTACHED BLAMAP - IF THE MW GIVEN IN THE BLAMAP IS DIFFERENT FROM WHAT IS ETCHED ON THE ROOT DO NOT PROCEED ANY FURTHER. CONTACT MAINTROL FOR FURTHER INSTRUCTION.
7. LUBRICATE ALL ITEMS LISTED IN AMM TASK 72-21-00-640-801-F00 PARA G.2. ENSURE THAT THE LUBRICANT IS UNIFORMLY DISTRIBUTED ON THE FAN BLADE DOVETAILS.
CAUTION: EXCESSIVE LUBE CAN LEAD TO VIBRATION, SMELL IN CABIN OR STREAKING ON THE BLADES. REFERENCE AMM TASK 70-10-05-600-801-F00 FOR APPLICATION OF LUBRICANT
8. INSTALL ENGINE FAN BLADES IAW AMM TASK 72-21-02-400-801-F00 AND IAW WITH ATTACHED BLAMAP CONFIGURATION
9. WHEN INSTALLING THE SPACERS, IF EXCESSIVE FORCE IS REQUIRED (MORE THAN THE FORCE OF TWO FINGERS) REPLACE WITH NEW SPACER FROM STOCK. IF NEW SPACER IS NOT AVAILABLE, CONTACT POWERPLANT@RYANAIR.COM AND RAISE A W/O IAW THE APPLICABLE OPERATOR`S CAME FOR SPACER REPLACEMENT.
10. ENSURE THE REAR SPINNER CONE AND RETAINING FLANGE ARE INSTALLED CORRECTLY. SEE AMM TASK 72-21-01-400-801-F00 SUBTASK 72-21-01-211-003-F00 FOR CLEARANCE CHECK. RECORD ON THIS W/O THAT THE CLEARANCE CHECK HAS BEEN COMPLETED AT THE 6 LOCATIONS AS ADVISED BY THE AMM.
11. ERASE ALL PREVIOUS BALANCE DATA FOR THIS ENGINE FROM THE AVM USING THE FOLLOWING PROCEDURE: - ACCESS THE BALANCE MENU ON THE AVM FRONT SCREEN - NAVIGATE TO THE BALANCE FUNCTION FOR THE APPRORIATE ENGINE - NAVIGATE TO THE "BALANCE 1 PLANE COMPUTE" MENU - PERFORM THE BALANCE AND REVIEW THE SOLUTION OFFERED - WHEN PROMPTED TO "SAVE NEW CONFIG" CLICK "YES" - DO NOT CHANGE THE WEIGHTS ON THE SPINNER AS SUGGESTED - PROCEED TO STEP 11 BELOW
12. THE PROCEDURE DETAILED ABOVE DELETES ALL IMBALANCE DATA PREVIOUSLY STORED ON THE AVM. FOR THE VIBRATION SURVEY WHICH FOLLOWS PLEASE ENSURE BALANCE WEIGHTS IN REAR SPINNER ARE SET TO A P07/P14 AND ENSURE THAT THIS BALANCE WEIGHT CONFIGURATION IS CONFIRMED IN THE AAVM PRIOR TO COMPLETION OF VIBRATION SURVEY.
13. ACCOMPLISH TEST 7 - VIBRATION SURVEY IAW AMM TASK 71-00-00-700-814-F00. REFER TO ATTACHED TECH TIP 72/014 FOR ADDITIONAL GUIDANCE.
14. C/OUT FAN TRIM BALANCE AS NECESSARY IAW AMM TASK 71-00-00-750-803-F00 TO GET THE VIBRATION DOWN TO A SATISFACTORY LEVEL. PLEASE ENSURE THAT A CONFIRMATION VIB SURVEY IS DONE AFTER EACH INDIVIDUAL FAN TRIM BALANCE UNTIL THE VIBRATION LEVELS ARE CONFIRMED TO BE SATISFACTORY
15. REMOVE THE RELATED BLADE DAMAGE CHART FROM THE RA805 (AIRCRAFT DAMAGE RECORD) AND RETURN TO TECHNICAL RECORDS. ANY CORRESPONDING DAMAGE THAT NO LONGER EXISTS AS A RESULT OF THE FAN BLADE CONFIGURATION CHANGE MUST HAVE ITS ENTRY UPDATED/CLOSED IN THE DAMAGE/REPAIR RECORD.
16. INSTALL A NEW BLADE DAMAGE CHART TO THE RA805 AND INPUT ANY EXISTING DAMAGE/REPAIR INFORMATION AS NECESSARY (REFER TO CAME 2.9.6)
17. RETURN AIRCRAFT TO A SERVICEABLE CONDITION
